title: Trap Pass Guide
summary: The Trap Pass starts as a key, then becomes a role mapper, thread tracker, mission proof object, public summary, and future access signal.

phases.title: Front Door
phases.summary: Public orientation. The visitor learns the map, sees the disclaimer spine, and reaches the pass claim path without needing an account yet.

phases.title: Claim The Key
phases.summary: Trap Pass ID, wave, serial, public summary, proof status, and holder role.
phases.unlock_signal: Create or recover a Trap Pass.

phases.title: Thread Witness
phases.summary: The pass carries thread affinity so the holder is not just a member; they are tied to a force inside the project.
phases.unlock_signal: Choose or inherit thread keys on the pass.

phases.title: Mission Proof
phases.summary: Missions, quote pulls, clip votes, proof posts, and proof baggies begin changing the pass state.

phases.title: Archive Witness
phases.summary: Higher-trust holders help sort evidence, thread clips, archive objects, and drops into the correct story wires.

phases.title: Proof Ready
phases.summary: Special access for Day One witnesses, Patreon supporters, heavier context, early drops, and deeper archive notes.
phases.unlock_signal: Manual role, Patreon role, or high unlock level.

phases.title: Proof Ready
phases.summary: Shareable pass summary for profiles and future access without exposing email or account-only details.
phases.unlock_signal: Public summary can support profiles and future access.
